title: genspark-ai/genoffice: a local office suite a coding agent can edit
friendlyTitle: GenOffice lets a coding agent edit real Office files on your computer
summary: GenOffice is an open-source office suite for documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDF, Markdown, and HTML, with a built-in agent. A genoffice command-line tool and an agent skill let Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor create and edit real .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx files locally. You bring your own model key. It runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. GitHub's daily TypeScript trending list had it at 191 stars today. The suite is Apache-2.0. The ee/ directory is reserved for enterprise modules under a separate license. The GenOffice and Genspark names are trademarks, so a fork needs its own branding.
friendlySummary: GenOffice is an open-source office suite for documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDF, Markdown, and HTML, with a built-in agent. A genoffice command-line tool and an agent skill let Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor create and edit real .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx files on your own computer. You bring your own model key. It runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. GitHub's daily TypeScript trending list had it at 191 stars today. The suite is Apache-2.0. The ee/ folder is reserved for enterprise modules under a separate license. The GenOffice and Genspark names are trademarks, so a fork needs its own name and logo.
whyItMatters: Use it when you want a coding agent to change a real Office file on your machine, instead of pasting a table into a chat and hoping the export survives. The key stays yours. Check the file after the agent edits it, especially formulas and layout. Do not treat the enterprise folder as part of the Apache grant.
